basic_living: Community services cover basic food, accommodation and routine first aid. There is no per-roster-size daily resource tax.
allowance_reason: One municipal deployment-and-handover allowance per scheduled main duty, included in the totals above; not a second reward.
shared_equipment: Permanent tools do not consume charges for their baseline action. Consumables and expedited treatment spend supplies. No core objective requires a purchased item.
fallback: With no resources, free basic actions, ordinary recovery and eligible community responders still permit the next main duty. Extra training, consumables and upgrades may be unavailable.

responders.eligible: Only fill vacancies when fewer than 3 present main characters can legally deploy.
responders.skills: Universal basic actions; no personal specialties or advanced relationship protocols.
responders.persistent_identity: Mission-scoped IDs; never substitute for a missing named role in character story.

camp.default: Unassigned heroes take basic sleep; heroes who did no day work also receive day-rest recovery.

conversation.uses_project: Only substantive personal plan/repair work; short story reading uses free two-scene window.

fatigue.deployment_rule: Current fatigue + known mission fatigue cost must be <=100. Reserve cost before confirmation; do not clamp away excess cost.
fatigue.same_day_redeployment: Permitted only if healthy and the second deployment also meets the projected-cost test.

injury.treated_ready_day: injury_day + 1, after the first overnight; 2 supplies per patient
injury.highest_withdrawal: If the hero is still incapacitated and not extracted when the displayed rescue deadline expires or the player confirms abandonment, transfer to long-term hospital care and remove from this campaign roster. No random roll.
injury.shared_gear: Recovered through the following settlement inventory transfer; no main-story key item is personally owned.
injury.fallback_epilogue: Long-term recovery / changed occupation, reflecting the facts recorded before withdrawal.

support.stage: Primary-duty phase only. A worker cannot also take the main duty. Taking a later side duty is legal, but forfeits idle-day rest.

growth.power_budget: Levels mainly unlock choices and modifiers; total extra base HP over the campaign <=2, base attack is not multiplied by level.
growth.new_recruit: Receives the chapter XP floor, cannot join a mission already settled, may join the subsequent optional duty if healthy.
